notes: The author asked for a racing game and then chose a closed street circuit with laps, which is route-circuit and the Circuit Racing preset; Racing carries P6 whatever shape it takes, because the street loop has to read as one continuous connected route. The city is a stated request rather than a suggestion, so settlement-density carries the few blocks of built-up ground the author wants around the track. The dealership is a shop players walk into and buy cars from, so building-interior and its P3 outside-to-inside transition are required by a feature that is plainly in the game rather than assumed. One shop does not make this a Simulation as well — there is no tycoon loop, just a building on the circuit — and the third lap crossing the start-finish line is the end of the run.
